proved: The product maps every schema-v1 contribution kind to a fixed Syzygy-owned label and renders the selected title and description through React text nodes.
HTML-, script-, and URL-shaped contribution metadata is escaped in the headless product render and does not create an image, script element, or active href.
Installed signed-package cards show the bounded contribution count and distinct declared host-kind labels without loading package-controlled UI code.
Installed-package MCP inspection returns a bounded count and contribution kind, ID, and title while omitting each contribution description, component bytes, and signatures.
The machine-readable platform contract advertises the exact text-only rendering tier and its executable-reference self-check command.
notProved: Contribution-specific input forms, output renderers, import/export file selection, icons, layout, navigation, or package-controlled components.
Importer or exporter labels grant filesystem, Drive, network, model, or direct project mutation authority; they remain declarations in the zero-import world.
Worst-case usability for every combination of 32 stored versions and 128 contributions, marketplace discovery, publisher reputation, or independent third-party UI interoperability.
Visual pixel-level behavior in a packaged webview or accessibility testing beyond semantic server-rendered markup.
